Resolves #21706

Related: #21704, #21705, #21346, #21761

Mounts `Neo.button.ThemeSwitcher` across all 23 standalone examples on `dev` under `examples/board/*` (7), `examples/scheduler/*` (10), `examples/gantt/*` (5), and `examples/timeline/*` (1); upgrades `examples/scheduler/meridian` from 1 theme to all 5 themes with custom `--mer-*` palettes while preserving `neo-theme-neo-dark` as its default; and wraps phone toolbars cleanly at `390 × 844` (keeping `Day`/`Week` grouped on `gantt/basic` and `Hour`/`Day` grouped on `scheduler/basic`).

Evidence: L3 (local Playwright Chromium Whitebox E2E + visual whole-page verification at `1440 × 900` and `390 × 844`) → L3 required (AC-1..AC-4).

## Deltas from ticket
- Census expanded from 16 to all **23** standalone planning/timeline examples on `dev` (`board/{cardEditor,columns,multiSelect}`, `gantt/dependencies`, `scheduler/{liveUpdates,resourceColumns,timeZones}` merged since ticket filing).
- On `scheduler/nonWorkingTime`, set `showText: false` on `ThemeSwitcher` so its 7-item desktop toolbar stays single-row (`56px`) at `1440 × 900`.
- Per-example start-theme resolution (`prefersDarkTheme`) is left untouched on `app.mjs` for #21761 (`resolveStartTheme()` in `src/util/Theme.mjs`).
- Unrelated pre-existing `origin/dev` failure in `test/playwright/e2e/scheduler/Zoom.spec.mjs:107` (`src/scheduler/Container.mjs#scrollToDate` zoom-out scroll clamping race) is out of scope, noted in `MESSAGE:baa3370b-3a41-41ba-a7e0-da1ebf6b5c4f` (#21758 / #21760).

## Cold look
Two independent readers without session context graded unlabelled before (`M`) vs after (`N`) whole-page pairs in swapped order (`M→N` and `N→M`):
- **`gantt/basic` (`390 × 844`):** Reader 1 (`M→N`) graded `M = 3/10`, `N = 6/10` (`N` wins); Reader 2 (`N→M`) graded `N = 8/10`, `M = 3/10` (`N` wins) — `M` clipped `"Edits sta"` and pushed `Working time`, `Day`, and `Week` off-screen (`594px`), whereas `N` places all controls and `ThemeSwitcher` in two balanced rows (`87px` / `757px` chart height).
- **`scheduler/meridian` (`1440 × 900`):** Reader 1 (`M→N`) graded `M = 7/10`, `N = 8/10` (`N` wins); Reader 2 (`N→M`) graded `N = 8/10`, `M = 7/10` (`N` wins) — both noted `N` exposes `[Neo Dark]` cleanly in `.meridian-mast` AND caught that `.neo-grid-view`'s `.neo-theme-neo-dark` shadowed Meridian's teal `Observation sequence` bar tokens with default blue; fixed by scoping Meridian's custom properties onto `.meridian-desk :is(.meridian-scheduler, .meridian-gantt) [class*="neo-theme-"]`.
